q: The Vice-President, Krishna Kant, released a book titled 'The Saga of Hyderabad Struggle in India's Freedom Movement' in May 2002. Who is the author of the book? A SHTA
options: V. H. Desai and C. Sudarshan
key_text: V. H. Desai and C. Sudarshan

q: Who was the Chief Minister of Hyderabad after the police action?
explanation: After the police action, Maj. Gen. J.N. Chaudhuri was Military Governor; ICS officer M.K. Vellodi then became Chief Minister (1 Dec 1949 – 6 Mar 1952), followed by Burgula Ramakrishna Rao (first elected CM).

q: "Join Indian Union" movement leader?
explanation: The leader of the 'Join Indian Union' movement (1947) was Swami Ramananda Tirtha of the Hyderabad State Congress.

q: When did the Nizam Government lift the ban on Hyderabad State Congress?
explanation: The Nizam banned the Hyderabad State Congress in September 1938 and lifted the ban in 1946 (April), after about eight years.
